name: team_planning_retire_unit
description: Retire a live unit in a scenario of a Team Planning plan. Its people keep their place until an assignment moves them. A unit with live sub-units is refused: move or retire them first. Setting the unit again with team_planning_set_unit brings it back. scenario_id defaults to the baseline, whose id is the plan's. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors. `note` is Markdown: links, **bold**, _italic_, lists and `code` render, a bare URL becomes a link, typed HTML shows as text and images render as links.

note.description: Why this is in the plan, such as why this person moves. Optional, at most 2000 characters; it never changes what the scenario resolves to. Deleting the plan erases it.
